children: United Natural Foods Inc. reported fiscal 2026 results with revenue of $31.15B and diluted earnings per share of $1.34, marking an improvement in net income to $84M from a loss of $118M a year earlier.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss) attributable to United Natural Foods, Inc.”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings (loss) per share”.
Revenue mix shifted toward the Natural segment, which grew 7% year-over-year to $17.1B and helped offset declines in the Conventional segment (down 11.5%) and Retail (down 7.9%).
Management accelerated channel and network optimization, closing and consolidating multiple distribution centers and retail stores and exiting the Allentown facility to improve network efficiency.
Operational productivity gains and lower operating expenses, along with higher distribution-center productivity, contributed to improved operating income and Adjusted EBITDA.

Increased investment in technology and automation, including higher IT and cloud spend and an ERP rollout; fiscal 2027 capital expenditure and cloud investment are expected to be about $300M for automation and platform upgrades.
Company completed recovery actions following a cybersecurity incident with insurance recoveries and continues supply-chain monitoring amid inflationary and procurement pressures.
